name: Scorpio Tankers Inc.
analyst_actions: 2026-09-04 | B of A Securities | reiterates Sell | 78.0->83.0
2026-06-30 | B of A Securities | lowers Underperform | 100.0->78.0
product: Marine transportation of refined petroleum products, diesel, gasoline, naphtha and fuel oil, on 75 owned tankers: 25 LR2, 36 MR, 14 Handymax, average age 10.2 years (2026-09-03 6-K). Demand comes from refinery dislocation, capacity shifted far from consumers, plus inventory restocking that lengthens voyages and raises ton-miles (2026-07-30 call).
demand: Price-led. Q2 2026 LR2 pool/spot TCE 77749 usd/day versus 50830 in Q1 2026 (2026-07-30 and 2026-05-05 6-Ks). Volumes fell: June 2026 seaborne refined product exports down 2.3 mb/d or 11pct year-on-year, with longer voyage distances offsetting, so growth is rate and ton-mile, not volume.
pricing_power: Rates falling back toward cash break-even. LR2 Q3-to-date 64900 usd/day versus Q2 77749, Handymax 25500 versus 49210 (2026-09-03 versus 2026-07-30 6-K). Drydock and off-hire costs rise, about 10.0M usd estimated for Q3 2026. A Middle East de-escalation removing the ton-mile premium and the 100k usd/day LR2 crude rates would compress margins.
competition: No direct service substitute exists; the low-cost rival is Chinese newbuild supply. Scorpio itself buys MRs, LR2s and VLCCs in China, so Chinese yards adding capacity could lift effective supply and cap rates. Older sanctioned shadow tonnage is cheap near-term competition but cannot serve compliant trades (2026-07-30 call, 2026-09-03 6-K).
market_strategy: CEO Emanuele Lauro, 2026-07-30 call: focus on strengthening our balance sheet, lowering our cost of capital, reducing our cash break evens, optimizing our fleet, securing attractive time charter contracts, returning capital to shareholders. Management added: our job is not to predict the cycle, our job is to be prepared for it. 2026-05-27: intention to repay all secured debt due 2028.
bull: Q2 2026 net income 387.5M usd, LR2 TCE 77749 usd/day, net cash ~1.3B usd (~26 usd/share), cash break-even below 11000 usd/day, 13 newbuilds on order, 85pct scrubber-fitted fleet, 0.45 dividend paid (2026-07-30 6-K).
bear: Q3-to-date LR2 TCE fell to 64900 and Handymax to 25500 from 49210 (2026-09-03 6-K); June 2026 product exports down 11pct y/y; 90d analyst net raises -2, median target change -1.06pct; insider sales mid-Sept.
falsifier: Q4 2026 MR pool/spot TCE prints below about 25000 usd/day, or realized LR2 Q3 2026 TCE settles below the 40188-42500 usd/day charter levels.
web_what_changed_30_90d: 30d: 2026-09-03 6-K Q3-to-date TCE update LR2 pool 64900 usd/day, MR 30000, Handymax 25500, plus 3 new charters (STI Gladiator and STI Jermyn LR2 at 40188 and 42500; STI Pontiac MR 23900); 2026-09-18 BTIG target 100 to 110; mid-Sept Form 4 and 144 insider sales; 2026-09-25 S-8. 90d: 2026-07-30 record Q2, net income 387.5M usd, dividend 0.45; 2026-07-01 200M usd 7.5pct notes redeemed.
web_true_now_not_modelled: Cash break-even below 11000 usd/day, lowest ever, and net cash about 1.3B usd or near 26 usd/share (2026-07-30 call). 605M usd converts at sub-1pct yield replaced 5-7.5pct debt. 85pct of fleet scrubber-fitted; 66pct of global LR2 fleet now trades crude, shrinking the effective product order book; 21pct of product fleet over 20 years, 31pct by 2028.
web_demand_product: Marine transportation of refined petroleum products, diesel, gasoline, naphtha and fuel oil, on 75 owned tankers: 25 LR2, 36 MR, 14 Handymax, average age 10.2 years (2026-09-03 6-K). Demand comes from refinery dislocation, capacity shifted far from consumers, plus inventory restocking that lengthens voyages and raises ton-miles (2026-07-30 call).
web_price_volume_mix: Price-led. Q2 2026 LR2 pool/spot TCE 77749 usd/day versus 50830 in Q1 2026 (2026-07-30 and 2026-05-05 6-Ks). Volumes fell: June 2026 seaborne refined product exports down 2.3 mb/d or 11pct year-on-year, with longer voyage distances offsetting, so growth is rate and ton-mile, not volume.
web_bottleneck: The company relieves a refining dislocation: capacity sits far from consumers and inventories are drawn, visible stocks down over 400 mb since the conflict, forcing long-haul shipments. Its own bottleneck is shipyard capacity, newbuilds only deliver 2026-2030, while effective supply stays constrained as 66pct of LR2s trade crude (2026-07-30 call).
web_who_benefits_next: Shipyards building the 13 ordered vessels (Jiangsu Hantong, Yangzi-Mitsui, Jingjiang Nanyang, Dalian, plus the VLCC joint-venture yards), scrubber suppliers, and long-haul refiners and traders. Second-order: bunker suppliers, ports, and peers owning modern eco product tonnage as aging and sanctioned ships exit (2026-09-03 6-K, 2026-07-30 call).
web_who_loses: Owners of old, unscrubbered or sanctioned tankers lose share as the modern scrubber-fitted fleet wins premium charters; crude-focused Aframax operators face LR2 crossover competition. Refiners and consumers pay higher freight, and sanctioned shadow-fleet tonnage is displaced from compliant trade (2026-07-30 call).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Rates falling back toward cash break-even. LR2 Q3-to-date 64900 usd/day versus Q2 77749, Handymax 25500 versus 49210 (2026-09-03 versus 2026-07-30 6-K). Drydock and off-hire costs rise, about 10.0M usd estimated for Q3 2026. A Middle East de-escalation removing the ton-mile premium and the 100k usd/day LR2 crude rates would compress margins.
web_low_cost_substitute: No direct service substitute exists; the low-cost rival is Chinese newbuild supply. Scorpio itself buys MRs, LR2s and VLCCs in China, so Chinese yards adding capacity could lift effective supply and cap rates. Older sanctioned shadow tonnage is cheap near-term competition but cannot serve compliant trades (2026-07-30 call, 2026-09-03 6-K).
web_ceo_promised: CEO Emanuele Lauro, 2026-07-30 call: focus on strengthening our balance sheet, lowering our cost of capital, reducing our cash break evens, optimizing our fleet, securing attractive time charter contracts, returning capital to shareholders. Management added: our job is not to predict the cycle, our job is to be prepared for it. 2026-05-27: intention to repay all secured debt due 2028.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes. 2026-05-27 promised 367.8M usd prepayment of 2028 secured debt; 2026-07-30 confirmed 389.1M usd repaid and five 2028 facilities terminated. 2026-07-01 promised redemption of the Nordic notes; completed 2026-07-17 at 106.4 to par. Convertible notes issued April and May 2026 at sub-1pct yield; 0.45 dividend paid 2026-06-15 and 2026-08-31.
web_what_would_falsify: If Q4 2026 MR pool/spot TCE prints below about 25000 usd/day, or realized LR2 Q3 2026 TCE settles below the new 40188 to 42500 usd/day charter levels, the ton-mile thesis breaks. Also fatal: a Middle East de-escalation normalising Hormuz and ending the 100k usd/day LR2 crude premium, or FY2026 adjusted EPS below the 11.43 consensus.
